Retrieved guidance [KB001] — Reset VPN password
Northstar demo policy: Open the employee password portal, choose Reset password, verify your identity with the registered factor, and set a new password. Reconnect the VPN with the updated password. Never send your password to this assistant. If identity verification fails, raise an IT ticket.

Retrieved guidance [KB002] — VPN connection troubleshooting
Check that your internet connection works. Close and reopen the approved VPN client. Record the exact error message and try reconnecting once. If it still fails, create a ticket with the error and approximate start time. These are fictional organization instructions.

Retrieved guidance [KB005] — Email sign-in help
Confirm that you are using your work account. Retry sign-in through the approved mail application. If your account is locked or the second factor is unavailable, raise an IT support ticket. Do not share verification codes.
